        for the IKE Network. External doc and code projects inherit

        use ike-workspace-maven-plugin (ws:* goals). Consumes ike-docs
        as an external artifact — ike-parent declares ike-doc-maven-plugin
        with extensions=true, resolving from Nexus at project-load time.
        Split from the archived ike-pipeline; see IKE-Network/ike-issues#216.

items.title:
network.ike.docs:ike-doc-ingest 90 发布, Reusable infrastructure for ingesting external content into IKE
        documentation corpus projects. Provides tarball download/extract,
        AsciiDoc topic-fragment writing with IKE-INGEST provenance
        attributes, topic-registry shard writing, and per-IG/per-source
        _includes.adoc emission. Source-specific parsers (FHIR NPM
        packages, FDA IFU PDFs, ISO standards, etc.) live in each
        corpus project's own ingest module and consume this library.

        ike-doc-maven-plugin (ike-doc packaging, AsciiDoc/render
        pipeline, PDF dispatch), the Koncept AsciiDoc extension,
        DocBook XSL + fonts, shared doc resources, and the semantic
        linebreak reformatter. Split from ike-pipeline to resolve the
        extensions=true reactor-load cycle. See IKE-Network/ike-issues#216.
